notes: ACCESS: Claude-in-Chrome connector only (own tab, tabId 1961714728). Homepage loaded directly, no WAF/interstitial. robots.txt names no Claude/anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot agent (only generic UA:* rules); it DOES Disallow /on/demandware.store/*, so the SFCC Search-Refinebar side-door used in the prior Home-Decor pass was deliberately NOT used this time -- all data came from public SEO category URLs. Platform: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Sites-CasaViva-Site). TREE SOURCE: the rendered mega-menu on the homepage (231 nav links harvested via same-origin DOM scrape) cross-checked against /sitemap_1-category.xml (508 category locs) so nothing outside the nav was missed; each candidate leaf page was then re-fetched same-origin and re-scanned for child category links to confirm it really is a leaf. QTY SOURCE: the site's own rendered result-count header -- element <div class='result-count' data-products-count='N'> whose visible text is literally 'N Resultados' (verified on the live rendered page for Sillas de comedor: data-products-count=60 rendering '60 Resultados'). SANITY CHECKS: (1) exhaustion cross-check on /muebles/sillas-y-taburetes/sillas-de-comedor/?start=0&sz=200 returned exactly 60 unique data-pid values, matching data-products-count=60 -> the counter is exact, not a display cap; same check ran clean on Sofas (17/17) and Mesas de comedor (19/19). (2) the number varies per category (2,3,4,5,7,10,11,15,16,17,19,23,31,60...) so it is not a site-wide constant. (3) h1 of every fetched page matched the intended node; /muebles/muebles-de-dormitorio/ correctly 404s rather than silently serving the parent. (4) Parent nodes are aggregates, exactly as the prior pass warned: /muebles/=218 vs sum of its branches 219 (1 product double-filed), /muebles/mesas/=68 vs 31+19+19=69, /muebles/sillas-y-taburetes/=62 = 60+2 exact, /terraza-y-jardin/muebles-de-jardin-y-exterior/=44 vs children summing 52 (garden sets counted under two nodes). Because of that, NO qty is recorded on any parent -- Tables, Bedroom Furniture, Chairs & Stools and Garden & Outdoor Furniture are grouping rows only. DUPLICATE URL DROPPED: /cocina/muebles-cocina/ returns byte-identical HTML to /muebles/auxiliares-de-cocina/ (same h1 'Muebles auxiliares de cocina', same 5 products, identical 343977-byte response) -- same node under two URLs, only the /muebles/ path is emitted. SEO FACET NODES DROPPED: /muebles/sofas/sofas-cama/ (3), /muebles/sofas/sofas-chaise-longue-esquineros/ (3), /muebles/sofas/sofas-exclusivos-online/ (5), /muebles/mesas/mesas-comedor/mesas-extensibles-comedor/ (2) and /muebles/mesas/mesas-comedor/mesas-redondas-comedor/ (1) exist in the sitemap but are absent from the mega-menu; product-ID set arithmetic proves each is a strict subset of its parent and they overlap one another rather than partitioning it (3+3+5=11 of Sofas' 17, and 'sofas exclusivos online' is a curated/marketing node per rule 3). Sofas and Dining Tables are therefore emitted as leaves with their own exact totals and flagged. EMPTY CATEGORY EXCLUDED: /muebles/sillas-y-taburetes/sillas-de-escritorio/ ('Sillas de escritorio', desk chairs) is a live nav node but currently carries 0 products -- HTTP 200, no result-count element, 0 data-pid tiles, 248006-byte empty-shell response matching the empty-category pattern documented in the prior pass; checked deliberately, not skipped, and excluded rather than emitted as a 0 row. OUT-OF-SCOPE EXCLUSIONS: /orden-del-hogar/almacenaje/ cajas, cestas, cestos-para-la-ropa, organizadores (standalone storage baskets/boxes -> future Storage task); /orden-del-hogar/colgadores-y-percheros/ (1 product, opened and title-checked: 'Perchero de pared con 3 ganchos de madera' = a wall hook rail, not a coat stand -> wall accessory, not furniture); /bano/ accesorios-de-bano, complementos-de-bano (incl. espejos = bathroom mirrors, Wall Decor's job), organizadores-de-bano, textil-de-bano; all of /comedor/ (tableware/glassware), /cocina/ (utensils, appliances, textiles), /salon/decoracion-salon/ (mirrors, wall art, clocks), lighting incl. /terraza-y-jardin/decoracion-de-jardin/iluminacion-exterior/, /terraza-y-jardin/parasoles-y-cenadores/ (parasols and gazebos = shade structures, not furniture), /terraza-y-jardin/textil-de-exterior/, /terraza-y-jardin/barbacoas/ (BBQs = appliances), and all /rebajas/*, /*-black-friday/, /campanas/*, /clau-and-chloe/*, /basicos-para-*/ and /muebles-madera-mango|microcemento|decoracion-azul|ecofriendly/ nodes (sale, seasonal-campaign, designer-collection and material-filter landing pages -> rule 3). JUDGEMENT CALLS INCLUDED: Shoe Racks & Shoe Cabinets sits under Orden del Hogar > Almacenaje but all 4 tiles are shoe cabinets and shoe benches ('Zapatero de madera MDF y acero Bruno', 'Banco zapatero bambu' x2, 'Zapatero de bambu Oliver') -> furniture per the storage-vs-furniture line, flagged; one of its 4 products also appears in Shelving Units. Bathroom Trolleys (/bano/carros-de-bano/) tiles are 'Mueble de bano de bambu 40x30x95cm', 'Carro de bano de bambu Karyl' and 'Estanteria de bambu para toallas 152cm' -> freestanding bathroom furniture, included under an Outdoor/Bathroom-style separate bucket and flagged; the towel shelving unit also appears in Shelving Units. Kitchen Auxiliary Furniture is kept (kitchen trolleys/carts, e.g. 'Carro de cocina negro'). Poufs are kept because the site files them under the Muebles department ('Pufs y reposapies').
